EU advances Ukraine accession as Hungary lifts veto, paving way for Zelenskyy-Magyar meeting

EU governments agreed to open two additional accession clusters with Ukraine after Hungary dropped its veto following an agreement on the rights of the ethnic Hungarian minority. Zelenskyy and Magyar may meet in Brussels later this week.
